title: Khoon Mein Dooba
body:
khoon mein dooba jalti zameen par
lashaa e sarwar pada hua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
doobta suraj charkhe bareen par
jaam lahoo ka bana hua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
farqe shahe deen kat gaya ran mein
kaisa hua andher ye ban mein
mehre imamat aaya gehan mein
hashr kahan ab ruka hua hai
khoon mein dooba...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab e muztar ka tha ye nauha
kaisa ye din kismat ne dikhaya
aah jo kal tak bhara hua tha
aaj wohi ghar luta hua hai
khoon mein dooba...
<<DIVIDER>>
roye na kyun kar bali sakina
khaye tamache chin gaye gohar
sooje huwe rukhsaron pe uske
khoon abhi tak jama hua hai
khoon mein dooba...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi nahi ye shimr se kehta
bali sakina ko na de eeza
uth gaya sar se baap ka saaya
uska bahot dil dukha hua hai
khoon mein dooba...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhal gaya suraj shamma jali
nanha mera asghar kahan gaya re
bano pukari kok jali
nanha mera asghar kahan gaya re
<<DIVIDER>>
raat andheri sunsan ban
dhoondun kahan tujhe ay gulbadan
ro ro pukare maa dil jali
nanha mera asghar kahan gaya re
<<DIVIDER>>
ran ko gaya tha jo shesh maah
teer galay par usne bhi khaaya
ek dukhiyari maa ka kaleja
naawak se gham se chida hua hai
khoon mein dooba...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehm kisi ko us par na aaya
cheen ke bistar le gaye aada
haye mera bemaar bhatija
ghash mein zameen par pada hua hai
khoon mein dooba...
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeediyat ko jad se ukhada
deen e nabi ko isne bachaya
ta qayamat sultan e shaheedan
zibha ho kar bhi fatha hua hai
khoon mein dooba...
author: Anwar Raebarelwi
